name: @proworks-hub/billingiq
description: BillingIQ — invoice generation where the convention is never the engine's to pick: proration and price basis required (six defensible answers spread 6.9% on one golden event), tier mode required (68% apart on one quantity), gapless numbering where every value is accounted for or burned with a record, a tax gate that never softens to zero, and corrections as instruments — credit note, void, refund request — never edits.
author: Steven Kreutzer
